content_fields.title: Enforce the use of client certificate bundles for unprivileged users to access UCP (Docker)
content_fields.description: Require client certificate bundles for unprivileged users accessing the container orchestration control plane.
content_fields.guidance: Access to the orchestration control plane should be authenticated with per-user client certificate bundles that carry the user's role, with short validity periods and revocation, so control-plane access is never granted by a shared credential.
content_fields.found: The deployment is a local Docker Compose stack; there is no UCP or equivalent orchestration control plane in the repository.
content_fields.missing: An orchestration control plane, its user directory and a certificate authority issuing the bundles.
content_fields.conclusion: There is no control plane in this deployment to configure; the control belongs to the container platform that would host the service.
content_fields.action: The container platform team should enforce client certificate bundles on the orchestration control plane.
